title: I know that he came
goal: Say what you know, heard or were told with -dYgY after bilmek, eşitmek and aýtmak.

intro.text: There is no word for **that**. The clause becomes a noun with `-dYgY` and the object of the verb: *Onuň gelendigini bilýärin* (I know he has come). The participle gives the tense: *gelendigini* (came), *gelýändigini* (is coming), *geljekdigini* (will come). Nouns take it directly: *mugallymdygyny*.

vocab.en: exact, precise; for sure (anyk bilmeýärin: I don't know for sure)

exercises.label: *gelmek*: (he knows) that I came, that you came…
exercises.explain: *gelen* + *-dik* (k → g before a vowel) + the possessive + the accusative; after **his**, **her**, **their**, an *n* first: *gelendigini*.

exercises.question: How do you say **I know that he has come**?

why.3: The doer goes in the genitive: *onuň gelendigini*.

exercises.explain: `-An` for what has happened: *onuň gelendigini bilýärin*.

exercises.gloss: (I know) that he came, as an object

exercises.en: Merjen said she would come tomorrow.

reject.why: After *aýtmak*, the clause needs *-dygy* and the accusative: *geljekdigini*.

accept: I heard that you got married!
I have heard you got married!
I heard you have got married!
I heard you have gotten married!

exercises.prompt: I know she works in Ashgabat.

reject.why: *Işländigini*: that she worked. She works there now: *işleýändigini*.
The doer goes in the genitive: *onuň işleýändigini*.
The clause is the object of *bilýärin*: *işleýändigini*.

exercises.label: *gelmek*: (she said) that I would come, that you would come…

accept: I do not know exactly where he works.
I do not know exactly where she works.
I do not know for sure where [he|she] works.
I am not sure where [he|she] works.

exercises.question: How do you say **I know she is a teacher**?

why.1: The fact is the object of *bilýärin*: *mugallymdygyny*.

exercises.prompt: I didn't know they had moved to Mary.
He didn't say when he would come.

reject.why: The clause needs *-dygy* and the accusative: *haçan geljekdigini*.

exercises.explain: The question word stays inside the clause: *haçan geljekdigini aýtmady*.

exercises.en: My dad doesn't know I have no money.

reject.why: *Ýok* has a rounded o, so the next syllable rounds: *ýokdugyny*.

exercises.explain: *ýok* + *-dug-y-ny*: that there is none, that I have none.

accept: I do not believe he has come.
I do not believe she has come.
I do not believe that [he|she] has come.
I do not believe that [he|she] came.
